batch_execution.method: Symbolica BatchExpressionEvaluator executes each instruction across active lanes

oracle.coefficient_convention: [t_mass^a t_eta^b], equal to partial derivatives divided by a! b!
oracle.expansion_variable: z=eta/M; mass dependence retained exactly before differentiation

integrated_series_cache.scope: process-local exact structural series keyed only by inclusive order

oracle.method: Independent routing-derived Symanzik parameter series; exact Symbolica polynomial integration and normalized derivatives
oracle.normalization: D0=integral_Delta3 (M+eta*P)^(-2) dx, volume(Delta3)=1/6; all pole components zero
oracle.remainder_proof: Coefficientwise absolute values of every omitted eta-series term and all normalized mass/eta derivatives are majorized by the positive generator; |M|>=L and 0<=P<=1 uniformly, then integrate with volume 1/6
oracle.rounding: Exact Complex<Rational> centers and Rational bounds; no floating-point evaluation
